list.sendNoDraft: Select drafts first: only drafts are sent.
list.keySend: Send the selected drafts (x selects the row)

sendMany.subtitle: One card per supplier: each order goes on its own, with its own confirm link.
sendMany.reading: Reading what each order needs before it goes…
sendMany.readFailed: Couldn't read the orders to send
sendMany.messageHint: Optional: added to each mail after the standard text.
sendMany.eachOwn: Each order is its own send: one refused does not stop the others.
sendMany.link: Each supplier gets a one-off link to confirm, propose other dates or quantities, or decline — no account.
sendMany.reminder: After the confirm-by time the buyer is alerted; reminders go only by hand until the Owner switches the automatic ones on.

held.reading: Wait: the orders are being read.
held.offline: Offline: nothing can be sent now.
held.none: None of these orders can go now: see each card.
held.notDraft: Not a draft any more: it was sent or changed meanwhile.
held.gone: Not found any more (removed, or another company's).
held.refused: It could not be read: open the order.

refused.conflict: not sent: it changed meanwhile — open it and send it again.
refused.invalid: not sent: something on the order is not right — open it.
refused.other: not sent: try it from the order.

sendMany.fake: On this computer the mail goes to the test mailbox only.

send.confirmByHint: Default {time} (48 hours, longer by the supplier's closed days). The buyer is alerted after it.
send.confirmByHintNone: Default: 48 hours after the send, longer by the supplier's closed days.
send.changesTold: The supplier reads what changed in revision {revision}:
send.changeNoteHint: Optional: why it changed, in the mail of this revision.
send.confirmByRefused: That confirm-by time cannot be used: pick a time after now, within the link's life.

change.title: Change {number}?
change.becomesDraft: The order becomes the draft of revision {revision}: change its lines and details, then send it.
change.linksStop: {supplier}'s links to answer stop working now; their answer is kept with revision history.
change.confirmedAgain: {supplier} confirmed this order: the new revision needs their confirmation again.
change.sendAfter: The supplier sees nothing until you send the new revision.
change.noteHint: Optional; kept with the order, never in a mail.
change.bannerHint: Sent orders are read-only. Change starts revision {revision}: the supplier sees it after you send it.
change.bannerReceived: Goods came: the order no longer changes. Cancel a line or close it short from ⋯ on the line.

held.draft: It is a draft: change it here and send it.
held.proposed: The supplier proposed changes: accept, refuse or counter-propose first.
held.received: Goods came: cancel a line or close it short instead.
held.closed: The order is closed or cancelled.

counter.title: Counter-propose on {number}?
counter.fromAsked: The supplier's changes are refused; revision {revision} starts from what you asked, to change and send.
counter.means: Counter-propose: revision {revision} from what you asked — change it and send it.

held.noProposal: No proposal waits for your decision.

revisionDraft.title: Revision {revision} draft — the supplier sees it after you send it
revisionDraft.nothingYet: Nothing changed yet against the revision the supplier has.
revisionDraft.unknown: What changed so far could not be read; the send shows it again.

revisions.title: Revisions
revisions.notSent: Not sent yet: revision 1 is made at the first send.
revisions.removedLine: a line no longer on the order

reminders.title: Reminders sent
reminders.busy: Wait: a change is being saved.
reminders.noDeadline: No time asked (sent before confirm-by times existed)
reminders.switchHint: The Owner's switch, off by default: until it is on, reminders go only by hand.
reminders.notWaiting: The order is not waiting for the supplier's answer: no reminder goes.
reminders.manualOnly_one: {count} reminder for this revision. Remind by hand when it is needed.
reminders.manualOnly_other: {count} reminders for this revision. Remind by hand when it is needed.
reminders.overdueManual_one: The confirm-by time passed; {count} reminder so far. The buyer was alerted.
reminders.overdueManual_other: The confirm-by time passed; {count} reminders so far. The buyer was alerted.
reminders.nextAutomatic_one: {count} reminder so far; the next automatic one {time}.
reminders.nextAutomatic_other: {count} reminders so far; the next automatic one {time}.
reminders.noMoreAutomatic_one: {count} reminder so far; no more automatic ones for this revision (at most 3).
reminders.noMoreAutomatic_other: {count} reminders so far; no more automatic ones for this revision (at most 3).

confirmBy.title: Move the confirm-by of {number}
confirmBy.label: Confirm by
confirmBy.hint: In the site's time; within the link's life.
confirmBy.same: That is the time already asked.
confirmBy.nothingSent: Nothing is sent to {supplier}: this is the office's deadline.
confirmBy.alert: The buyer's alert follows the new time.
confirmBy.passed: Passed: the supplier did not answer in time.
confirmBy.refused: That time cannot be used: pick one after now, within the link's life.

held.notSent: Only a sent order waiting for its answer has a confirm-by time.

remind.title: Remind {supplier}
remind.noLink: The mail carries the order's PDF, not the link: it asks to use the link received, or to reply for a new one.
remind.before_one: {count} reminder already went for this revision.
remind.before_other: {count} reminders already went for this revision.
remind.fake: On this computer the mail goes to the test mailbox only.
remind.messageHint: Optional: after the standard text, in the supplier's language.

held.notWaiting: Only a sent order waiting for its answer is reminded.
held.noEmail: The order's contact has no e-mail: pick another contact (Edit details).

held.newInDraft: New in this draft: remove it instead.
held.cameCloseShort: Goods came for it: close it short instead.
held.proposed: Accept or refuse the supplier's changes first.
held.orderClosed: The order is closed: nothing to cancel.
held.allCame: Everything came: nothing is left to close.
held.nothingCame: Nothing came yet against the order: cancel the line instead.
held.nothingCameLine: Nothing came for this line yet: cancel it instead.
held.allCameLine: It came in full: nothing is left to close.

closeShort.title: Close short
closeShort.means: The rest of a line will not come: closing it short ends what is still expected; planning releases it (the plan line is open again).
closeShort.none: No line can be closed short now.
closeShort.can: Part came: may be closed short

end.cancelMeans_one: The line stays on the order as cancelled: nothing more of it is expected.
end.cancelMeans_other: The lines stay on the order as cancelled: nothing more of them is expected.
end.closeMeans_one: What came stays; the rest of the line is no longer expected.
end.closeMeans_other: What came stays; the rest of the lines is no longer expected.
end.plan_one: {count} plan line opens again in What to buy & make.
end.plan_other: {count} plan lines open again in What to buy & make.
end.withRevision: The supplier reads it with revision {revision} when you send it.

cancel.confirmed: {supplier} confirmed this order: cancelling ends a contract. They are told at once.

reach.waiting: Wait: what this reaches is being read.
reach.noOrders: No work or customer order of the latest plan depends on it.
reach.noPlan: The site has no plan yet: what depends on it is not known.

held.lastLines: These are the last open lines: cancel the order instead.
held.atDock: Goods for it are at the dock (an open receipt): post or reverse the receipt first.
held.other: It cannot be done now: read the order again.

refused.changed: Someone changed the order meanwhile: it was read again — look and try again.

notice.changed: Revision {revision} is a draft: change it, then send it.
notice.countered: The supplier's changes are refused: revision {revision} is a draft to change and send.
notice.closedShort_one: {count} line closed short: planning releases the rest.
notice.closedShort_other: {count} lines closed short: planning releases the rest.
notice.confirmByMoved: The confirm-by time moved; the alert follows it.
